target.title: fix(streams): preserve stable results when body cleanup fails
target.body:
Related: #111156

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where proxy validation, Microsoft Teams attachment downloads, and gateway loopback preflight could replace an already-determined status, unavailable result, or byte-limit diagnostic with a later response-body cleanup rejection.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discarded response bodies now explicitly observe and suppress only cancellation failures after the authoritative outcome is known. The gateway path also uses the shared bounded-response reader, deleting its duplicate implementation while preserving genuine mid-stream read errors and reader-lock cleanup.

## User Impact

Users and operators now receive the stable result from the original operation even when best-effort Web Streams cleanup fails. Real response-read failures continue to propagate normally.

## Evidence

- Focused native-stream regressions cover all six affected early-return/overflow paths, cancellation rejection, unhandled-rejection observation, listener cleanup, reader-lock cleanup where the owning reader is local, and mid-stream error propagation: 56 tests passed across 3 Vitest shards.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/net/proxy/proxy-validation.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/attachments/bot-framework.test.ts src/gateway/gateway-cli-backend.live-probe-helpers.test.ts`
- Changed-surface Testbox proof: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29675969246. Formatting and repository policy gates passed; the run then stopped on the Plugin SDK API baseline, independently reproduced on clean `origin/main` at `25a8b33ff50f` with no SDK files changed by this branch.
- Fresh branch autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings (0.94 confidence).

AI-assisted: yes. The maintainer agent reviewed the full owning modules, callers, sibling bounded-reader implementation, adjacent tests, and the upstream Web Streams cancellation/reader-lock contract before implementation.
